name: SauceDemo — self-heal test
description: Deliberately broken selectors on fill/click steps, marked strict so the resolver's description fallbacks cannot recover them first — only the healer may. With --heal, the healer should recover each one through the embed cascade (no AI call needed if MiniLM scores >= 0.85). The final assert is what makes this a test rather than a demo: without it the run passes even when the login never happened.

steps.description: Type username into the username field
Type password into the password field
Click the Login button to submit credentials
Inventory page rendered — the healed login actually worked
Capture the inventory page for the report
